reason: The cited evidence does not support the key premises. E1 discusses oxidation resistance of a different MPEA at 1200°C, not wear-induced oxide removal. E2 describes room-temperature mechanical properties of a eutectic HEA, not its corrosion or oxide behavior. E3 describes pitting corrosion of a eutectic HEA in a chloride solution, but does not mention mechanical wear or oxide removal by wear. None of the cited passages provide evidence for wear-induced oxide removal, exposure of fresh surfaces, or the coupling of wear and corrosion.
premises: A protective oxide film forms on the eutectic HEA at elevated temperature.
Mechanical wear can remove this protective oxide film.
Removal of the oxide film exposes fresh, reactive metal surfaces.
Exposed fresh surfaces accelerate localized corrosion.
Differential oxide formation on fcc and B2 phases contributes to heterogeneous corrosion.
